description.value: Though the evolution of loupain languages has changed the face of communication amongst loupes, some loupain still utilize barks, whines, and growls to punctuate, accentuate, or exclaim in their sentences. You can bypass some elements of the Linguistic trait’s limitations of requiring to know or speak the same language when using Auditory effects, though more complex messages, typically those that are more than a simple sentence Request or Demoralize will still fail if you do not share a language. You also gain a +1 circumstance bonus to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.DCb62iCBrJXy0Ik6]{Request}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{Lie} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize}if your target is particularly receptive to the sounds you make.
